Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

About the role:

Lead a world-class Mobile Platform Engineering organization at ServiceNow that powers AI-native enterprise experiences across iOS and Android. This leader will hire exceptional mobile and AI talent, establish an AI-forward engineering culture, and deliver scalable mobile platform capabilities for purpose-built enterprise applications.

Lead Mobile Platform Strategy and Execution

Own the technical roadmap for enterprise mobile platform capabilities across Android and iOS.
Establish and run on-call rotations, incident response processes, and a blameless postmortem culture that drives reliability improvements.
Define reusable frameworks, SDKs, and platform patterns that accelerate application development across multiple product teams.
Partner with Product, Design, AI, Infrastructure, and Business leaders to deliver differentiated mobile experiences.
Drive excellence in performance, reliability, security, scalability, and operational rigor across the mobile platform.

Architect Enterprise Mobile Experiences

Design mobile platform capabilities for purpose-built enterprise applications across customer service, field service, operations, and productivity workflows.
Lead architecture for synchronization, offline-first experiences, notifications, inbox experiences, real-time interactions, and workflow execution.
Ensure applications perform reliably in low-connectivity and offline environments while meeting enterprise-grade security, privacy, and compliance requirements.
Create seamless experiences across mobile clients, AI services, platform capabilities, and enterprise workflows.

Provide Technical Leadership

Lead critical architecture reviews and complex technical decisions across mobile, platform integration, and application layers.
Own the mobile build and delivery pipeline, including CI/CD reliability, build speed and test infrastructure.
Establish standards for observability, telemetry, mobile performance benchmarking, release quality, and production readiness.
Mentor Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers, Principal Engineers, and senior technical contributors.
Advance mobile innovation through AI-enabled workflows, modern development practices, and strong engineering fundamentals.

Qualifications

12+ years of software engineering experience with significant experience leading mobile engineering organizations (Android and iOS).
3+ years leading engineering managers or multi-team organizations.
Strong technical depth in mobile architecture, APIs, distributed systems, cloud-native services, networking, security, data synchronization, and MAM/MDM enterprise integrations.
Track record building and scaling enterprise-grade mobile applications or mobile platforms used at large scale.
Experience managing Engineering Managers and senior technical leaders.

Specific AI Skills We Value

Experience building or integrating generative AI, LLM-powered experiences, AI agents, or copilots into mobile or enterprise applications.
Working knowledge of RAG, prompt engineering, agent orchestration, tool use, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and AI safety principles.
Familiarity with AI platforms and frameworks such as Azure AI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or comparable ecosystems.
Understanding of on-device AI patterns, small language models, speech or vision models, real-time inference constraints, and mobile latency tradeoffs.
Experience applying AI to engineering productivity, including code generation, test generation, automated review, incident analysis, or quality automation.
Ability to translate emerging AI capabilities into practical, secure, enterprise-grade mobile workflows.

Description

Amazon Software Builder Experience (ASBX), started in 2022, is working to make Amazon the best place to build software. Every day, hundreds of thousands of Amazon software builders rely on us for the tools they build with, and for the technology, training, and community behind them. One of our most important responsibilities is shaping the language ecosystem, both inside Amazon and across the open-source community, to improve the experience for every software builder.

The Role

We are seeking a Director of Software Development to lead Language Foundations, the organization that owns Amazon's programming-languages strategy across our strategic languages (Java, Rust, Python, TypeScript, Go, C/C++, Kotlin, and Swift) and represents that strategy to the language community: the engineers who specialize in language design, compilation, and optimization, along with standards bodies and the open-source ecosystems Amazon depends on. This leader recruits and leads some of the world's foremost language specialists, many of them Principal Engineers with deep standing in their fields.

Language Foundations shapes and influences the direction of the world's most critical programming languages. Amazon sits on the Rust Foundation board, is one of the distributors of OpenJDK (Amazon Corretto), and sponsors resident engineers who are among the top contributors in their communities. This leader is central to Amazon's large-scale language modernization, owning the tooling and language foundations that enable teams to move to modern languages and runtimes and transform the performance, efficiency, and safety of the software they run. It is simultaneously a community-shaping and an internal-modernization challenge: strengthening the ecosystems that Amazon and the industry rely on, while helping modernize some of the largest services in the world.

Key job responsibilities

Own the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for Language Foundations, connecting it to builder impact: code quality, reliability, security, performance, and the enablement of agent-supervised development.
Deliver best-in-class support for Amazon's strategic languages (Java, Rust, Python, TypeScript, Go, C/C++, Kotlin, and Swift), aligning internal toolchains with industry conventions so builders and agents work on modern runtimes out of the box.
Lead Amazon's language modernization through the tooling and language foundations that transform the performance, efficiency, and safety of the software teams build and run, including large-scale Rust and Java runtime investments.
Build the trusted, secure repository for the third-party software Amazon depends on, curating out unmaintained and vulnerable dependencies so builders start from a safe default.
Shape the external direction of strategic programming languages through Amazon's participation in standards bodies, foundations (e.g., the Rust Foundation, OpenJDK), and the open-source community, while maintaining the cultural norms of those communities.
Lead and grow a multi-team engineering organization: recruit and develop world-class language specialists and Principal Engineers and build the leadership bench.
Influence strategy and technical direction at the most senior levels of the company through clear written narrative and data; briefs at CEO-level reviews.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent work experience.
10+ years of software development experience, including systems software, compilers, language runtimes, or developer toolchains.
5+ years managing people, with 3+ years managing multiple managers or teams.
Experience developing long-term technical vision and strategy and influencing leadership decisions.
Experience delivering large-scale technical programs across multiple teams or organizations.

Master's or PhD in Computer Science or Engineering, with 10+ years of relevant experience.
A leadership position on a team delivering solutions at Amazon or industry scale.
Proven track record of attracting, developing, and retaining top language and systems specialists, including engineers with standing in the open-source community.

Deep expertise in programming language design, runtimes, compilers, or developer ecosystems, with recognized standing in the language community.

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

Anthropic manages one of the largest and fastest-growing infrastructure fleets in the industry — spanning multiple accelerator families, CPU families, and clouds. The Capacity Engineering team is responsible for making sure all of our infrastructure resources are accounted for, well-utilized, and efficiently allocated. We own the data, tooling, and operational systems that let Anthropic plan, measure, and maximize utilization across first-party and third-party compute — one of the company's largest areas of spend.

As the Senior Engineering Manager for Capacity Engineering, you will lead the team that builds and operates these production systems. You'll set technical direction, grow and develop a team of senior and staff-level engineers, and be accountable for the reliability and correctness of surfaces that leadership, research engineering, inference, infrastructure, and finance all depend on. This is a hands-on leadership role and will be onsite 5 days a week: we expect you to stay close enough to the systems to review designs, make sound architectural calls, and step into an incident when the team needs you — while spending most of your time on people, priorities, and cross-organizational alignment.

The team's work spans three overlapping areas, and you'll be responsible for balancing investment across them as business priorities shift:

Data platform — Pipelines that ingest occupancy and utilization telemetry from Kubernetes clusters, normalize billing and usage across cloud providers, and serve the BigQuery tables the rest of the org queries against. Consumers range from research engineers to finance to leadership, so this is product work as much as engineering.
Planning and Assurance — Making the state of the fleet legible and actionable in real time: cluster health tooling, capacity planning platforms, alerting on occupancy drops and allocation problems, and systemic fixes to scheduling and fragmentation.
Efficiency — Measuring and improving how effectively every major workload uses the hardware it runs on, across training, inference, and evals. Building benchmarking infrastructure and per-config baselines, then partnering with system-owning teams to close the gaps.

Key Responsibilities

Be hands-on, lead and grow the team. Hire, onboard, coach, and retain senior and staff engineers. Set clear expectations, give direct and timely feedback, run performance and leveling conversations, and build a team culture that values ownership, rigor, and collaboration.
Champion your internal customers. We build for our own use cases, so the teams that depend on our systems — research engineering, inference, infrastructure, and finance — are your customers. Engage with them directly, bring what you learn back into the roadmap, and lead the team in building tools people genuinely want to use.
Own the roadmap. Translate company-level compute strategy into a prioritized engineering roadmap across data platform, planning and efficiency. Make explicit trade-offs when priorities compete, and communicate them clearly upward and outward.
Set the technical bar. Review designs, weigh in on architecture, and hold the team to production standards — well-tested Python and SQL, latency and completeness SLOs, gap detection, and on-call that is sustainable.
Run the team as a product organization. Ensure the team gathers its own requirements, defines schema contracts, and designs for a wide range of consumers — from research engineers to a CFO. Treat data quality and discoverability as first-class deliverables.
Be the primary partner for cross-functional stakeholders. Work closely with infrastructure, inference, research engineering, and finance leadership to align on capacity decisions, efficiency targets, and spend. Represent the team's data and recommendations to senior leadership.
Drive operational excellence. Own reliability and incident response for load-bearing systems, establish SLOs and on-call practices, and continuously reduce operational toil so the team can spend its time on higher-leverage work.
Scale the function. As the fleet diversifies (every new provider is a net-new integration), anticipate where the team needs to grow in headcount, skills, and systems — and make the case for it.

What You Bring

Experience managing software or infrastructure engineering teams, including hiring senior engineers, managing performance, and developing people into larger scope.
A strong technical background in production systems — data engineering, infrastructure, distributed systems, or observability — with hands-on experience you can still draw on when reviewing designs or debugging with the team.
Familiarity with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure), Kubernetes-based infrastructure, and modern observability stacks (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana).
A track record of setting and executing an engineering roadmap in an ambiguous, high-autonomy environment with many stakeholders and shifting priorities.
Excellent communication skills: you can explain a utilization metric to a research engineer and a spend forecast to a CFO, and you can advocate clearly for your team's priorities with senior leadership.
Comfort owning operational responsibility for systems the company depends on, including on-call and incident management.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading teams working on capacity planning, resource management, product engineering or FinOps at a hyperscaler or in a large-scale ML environment.
Familiarity with accelerator infrastructure — GPU metrics (DCGM), TPU utilization, or ML training and inference systems at the hardware level.
Experience with multi-cloud billing and telemetry normalization (billing exports, reservation APIs, commitments, on-demand capacity reservations).
Experience building or leading internal data products with self-service access, schema contracts, and documentation.
Background in scheduling, packing efficiency, or profiling-driven optimization of large distributed workloads.

$405,000—$485,000 USD

Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

Anthropic manages one of the largest and fastest-growing infrastructure fleets in the industry — spanning multiple accelerator families, CPU families, and clouds. The Capacity Engineering team is responsible for making sure all of our infrastructure resources are accounted for, well-utilized, and efficiently allocated. We own the data, tooling, and operational systems that let Anthropic plan, measure, and maximize utilization across first-party and third-party compute — one of the company's largest areas of spend.

As the Senior Engineering Manager for Capacity Engineering, you will lead the team that builds and operates these production systems. You'll set technical direction, grow and develop a team of senior and staff-level engineers, and be accountable for the reliability and correctness of surfaces that leadership, research engineering, inference, infrastructure, and finance all depend on. This is a hands-on leadership role and will be onsite 5 days a week: we expect you to stay close enough to the systems to review designs, make sound architectural calls, and step into an incident when the team needs you — while spending most of your time on people, priorities, and cross-organizational alignment.

The team's work spans three overlapping areas, and you'll be responsible for balancing investment across them as business priorities shift:

Data platform — Pipelines that ingest occupancy and utilization telemetry from Kubernetes clusters, normalize billing and usage across cloud providers, and serve the BigQuery tables the rest of the org queries against. Consumers range from research engineers to finance to leadership, so this is product work as much as engineering.
Planning and Assurance — Making the state of the fleet legible and actionable in real time: cluster health tooling, capacity planning platforms, alerting on occupancy drops and allocation problems, and systemic fixes to scheduling and fragmentation.
Efficiency — Measuring and improving how effectively every major workload uses the hardware it runs on, across training, inference, and evals. Building benchmarking infrastructure and per-config baselines, then partnering with system-owning teams to close the gaps.

Key Responsibilities

Be hands-on, lead and grow the team. Hire, onboard, coach, and retain senior and staff engineers. Set clear expectations, give direct and timely feedback, run performance and leveling conversations, and build a team culture that values ownership, rigor, and collaboration.
Champion your internal customers. We build for our own use cases, so the teams that depend on our systems — research engineering, inference, infrastructure, and finance — are your customers. Engage with them directly, bring what you learn back into the roadmap, and lead the team in building tools people genuinely want to use.
Own the roadmap. Translate company-level compute strategy into a prioritized engineering roadmap across data platform, planning and efficiency. Make explicit trade-offs when priorities compete, and communicate them clearly upward and outward.
Set the technical bar. Review designs, weigh in on architecture, and hold the team to production standards — well-tested Python and SQL, latency and completeness SLOs, gap detection, and on-call that is sustainable.
Run the team as a product organization. Ensure the team gathers its own requirements, defines schema contracts, and designs for a wide range of consumers — from research engineers to a CFO. Treat data quality and discoverability as first-class deliverables.
Be the primary partner for cross-functional stakeholders. Work closely with infrastructure, inference, research engineering, and finance leadership to align on capacity decisions, efficiency targets, and spend. Represent the team's data and recommendations to senior leadership.
Drive operational excellence. Own reliability and incident response for load-bearing systems, establish SLOs and on-call practices, and continuously reduce operational toil so the team can spend its time on higher-leverage work.
Scale the function. As the fleet diversifies (every new provider is a net-new integration), anticipate where the team needs to grow in headcount, skills, and systems — and make the case for it.

What You Bring

Experience managing software or infrastructure engineering teams, including hiring senior engineers, managing performance, and developing people into larger scope.
A strong technical background in production systems — data engineering, infrastructure, distributed systems, or observability — with hands-on experience you can still draw on when reviewing designs or debugging with the team.
Familiarity with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure), Kubernetes-based infrastructure, and modern observability stacks (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana).
A track record of setting and executing an engineering roadmap in an ambiguous, high-autonomy environment with many stakeholders and shifting priorities.
Excellent communication skills: you can explain a utilization metric to a research engineer and a spend forecast to a CFO, and you can advocate clearly for your team's priorities with senior leadership.
Comfort owning operational responsibility for systems the company depends on, including on-call and incident management.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading teams working on capacity planning, resource management, product engineering or FinOps at a hyperscaler or in a large-scale ML environment.
Familiarity with accelerator infrastructure — GPU metrics (DCGM), TPU utilization, or ML training and inference systems at the hardware level.
Experience with multi-cloud billing and telemetry normalization (billing exports, reservation APIs, commitments, on-demand capacity reservations).
Experience building or leading internal data products with self-service access, schema contracts, and documentation.
Background in scheduling, packing efficiency, or profiling-driven optimization of large distributed workloads.

A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

. From the moment they say '“go” until the contract is fulfilled. We are only successful when the customer's mission is successful.

Mission Readiness is the post-production shared services organization for Anduril. This team supports the Business Lines and Divisions throughout the lifecycle of their product, from initial sustainment concept through delivery, installation, operation, repair and return. These service offerings also include providing technical publications, training, customer support, connectivity services and other value-added services. To the degree the Business elects, we accept the delegated responsibility for upfront and continued delivery of the committed service solutions. This team endeavors to provide the Business Lines, as our internal customers, shared mission services that are more efficient and cost effective than if they chose to provide them directly. By offering mission support capabilities and capacity that are not “core” to the Business, the Business can focus resources on addressing the next big need while we ensure existing commitments are met.

About The Job

We are looking for a Head of Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul (MRO) to join our rapidly growing team in Columbus, OH or Costa Mesa, CA
. In this role, you will be responsible for establishing and running the repair function for Anduril products and components. You will need to lay out the roadmap for product maintenance, leveraging the ground taken by various product teams to date, to enable the high volume and complexity of the fast-growing Anduril installed base. This will require working with the Business Lines - our internal customers - and their Production teams to isolate what makes their products (hardware, embedded software and related aftermarket services) unique and what they have in common that can result in scalable efficiencies. Anduril moves quickly, so “building the plane while flying” rules apply. If you are someone who knows how what great MRO organizations need, where they go wrong and want to create one from a clean sheet using all your lessons learned, then this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

Establish MRO function for Anduril; aggregate the limited existing team, provide strategic and tactical direction, and build out team skills and capacity.
Design and build the MRO organization (including staffing, footprint, tools and processes).
Collaborate closely with Production (including manufacturing, supply chain, material planning, scheduling) to ensure material needs are met for the used/repaired product availability to support deployed equipment uptime commitments as well as sub-component material needs.
Coordinate with supply chain and programs to manage subcontract component repairs, where applicable, and conduct insource/outsource decisions in support of business line priorities.
Prioritize repair backlog, turn-around-time (TAT) and costs in support of all Divisions/Business Lines priorities

Required Qualifications

Bachelors degree in technical or business discipline
10+ years of combined experience in aircraft systems/components MRO (required), sustainment, operations, quality, program management, and/or customer support functions
Ability to travel 25-75% of the time (depending on base location)
This position is based in Costa Mesa, CA or Columbus, OH and requires being onsite - remote work not considered
Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret or Top Secret security clearance

Preferred Qualifications

Extensive technical experience in maintenance, repair, and overhaul, including a comprehensive understanding of aircraft systems, components, and avionics.
Strong knowledge of maintenance best practices, troubleshooting techniques, and diagnostic tools used in the military aviation industry.
Experience managing complex MRO projects, including coordinating with OEMs, subcontractors, and maintenance crews.
Proven track record of successfully building and leading technical teams and overseeing MRO operations for a variety of products.
Proficient in interpreting technical manuals, schematics, and engineering drawings related to component, system and/or aircraft MRO.
Familiarity with military regulations and requirements related to MRO, such as DoD standards and military airworthiness criteria.
Experience ‘standing up’ MRO organization(s), particularly in the context of products ramping production and fielding
Prior success leading in a complex/matrix organization supporting multiple product families. Ability to influence decisions and collaborate in a cross-functional environment.
Understanding of reliability-centered maintenance (RCM) principles and experience in implementing maintenance programs for both condition-based and hard-time maintenance.
Knowledge of software systems used in MRO operations, such as computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS) and aircraft health monitoring systems.
MBA or advanced technical degree preferred

US Salary Range

$253,000—$300,000 USD

new_jobs.description:
Description

Do you want to work to make Power for Good?

We're the world's largest independent renewable energy company, guided by a simple yet powerful vision to create a future where everyone has access to affordable, zero carbon energy.

We know that achieving our ambitions would be impossible without our people. Because we're tackling some of the world's toughest problems, we need the very best people to help us. They're our most important asset so that's why we continually invest in them.

RES is a family with a diverse workforce, and we are dedicated to the personal and professional growth of our people, no matter what stage of their careers they're at. We can promise you rewarding work which makes a real impact, the chance to learn from inspiring colleagues from across a growing, global network and opportunities to grow personally and professionally.

Our competitive package offers a wide range of benefits and rewards.

The position

RES is establishing a Director of Applications and AI Automation to lead the build engine for its enterprise application estate and its AI-enabled solutions. Reporting to the Group Chief Information Officer, the role owns the strategy, delivery and governance of application development, automation and real-time integration across RES — from core ERP through to AI agents and automations — within the company's Demand to Build to Run operating model and a flat-cost funding constraint.

The role brings together, under a single leader: ERP development on IFS; custom and legacy application development; low-code and citizen development on the Power Platform; workflow, robotic and agentic automation; real-time application integration on Boomi; and the AI application platform on which RES builds — the model gateway, agent runtime and registry, and the associated evaluation and consumption controls.

The role also sets the standard for AI-assisted software development across RES engineering, and governs the development and use of AI-enabled applications and automations. It is a key leader for enterprise-wide AI governance via collaboration with the leader of Data and AI Analytics.

The role reports to the Group CIO and can be based in the United Kingdom or Spain. Fluency in Spanish is preferred.

Accountabilities

Set and own the applications, automation and AI-solutions strategy and roadmap, aligned to demand shaped by Business Technology and gated through Delivery Governance.
Lead ERP development on IFS while incorporating and winding down legacy ERP platforms.
Lead custom and legacy application development and own the development and lifecycle direction of the existing application portfolio.
Own automation across RES — low-code and citizen development on the Power Platform, workflow and robotic automation, and agentic solutions — setting the platforms, standards and governance under which business functions build their own automations.
Own real-time application integration on Boomi, ensuring reliable, secure and well-documented interfaces between applications, including any interface that writes into a system of record.
Own the AI application platform — model gateway, agent runtime and registry, evaluation practice and consumption cost control — operated as a shared service, with a defined service commitment to Data and AI Analytics for the model and machine-learning workloads it takes on as that capability is matured.
Set group-wide standards for AI-assisted software development, covering agentic development tooling, code provenance, review and security expectations, applying to every engineering team across IT.
Govern the development and use of AI-enabled applications and automations, setting responsible-AI, quality, security and lifecycle standards, and contribute to the cross-functional AI governance forum without owning it.
Ensure every solution is designed for the Demand to Build to Run model and handed cleanly to Platform Operations against defined run-readiness criteria.
Deliver effective solutions that drive efficiency and a focus on value for RES.
Uphold architecture conformance with Enterprise and Solution Architecture, and security-by-design with Cyber Security.
Build, develop and lead a high-performing, globally distributed team across the United Kingdom, the United States, Spain and offshore.
Manage vendors, licences and budgets across the application, integration and AI platform estate, within the group commercial framework owned by the Office of the CIO.

Knowledge

Enterprise application landscapes, including ERP (IFS or comparable) and their role in an asset-intensive business.
Modern application development, integration patterns and platform-based delivery.
Automation platforms and practice: low-code and citizen development, workflow and robotic automation, and agentic solutions.
AI application platforms: model gateways, agent runtimes, retrieval and tool-access patterns, evaluation practice and consumption cost management.
Responsible-AI practice, and the governance of AI-assisted development.
Application integration platforms (Boomi or comparable) and real-time interface design.
Demand-build-run, or product and platform, operating models and run-readiness disciplines.

Skills

Setting strategy and translating shaped business demand into deliverable, supportable solutions.
Leading and developing distributed, multi-country technical teams, including through re-skilling.
Delivering to quality, security and lifecycle standards within fixed cost envelopes.
Holding a working boundary with a peer function without escalating routine decisions.
Strong commercial, vendor and budget management.
Clear stakeholder management and communication to executive level.

Experience

Senior leadership of application development or digital delivery functions at scale, ideally in asset-intensive, energy or infrastructure sectors.
Delivering ERP (IFS or comparable) alongside modern application, automation and AI capabilities.
Putting AI-enabled applications or agents into production use, with the governance to match.
Taking ownership of legacy application estates and setting a clear modernisation or retirement path.
Operating a demand-build-run or product and platform operating model with a clean build-to-run handover.

Qualifications

Degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
Relevant professional certifications — for example in enterprise architecture, application or integration platforms, portfolio delivery, or responsible AI — are advantageous.
Fluency in Spanish is preferred.

Health can’t wait
.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance.
Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a
unique culture
. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🤖 Who we are

Alan Clinic. A health companion and a digital clinic for everyone.

We're a Small Team Within Alan, On a Mission To Redefine The Future Of Care By democratizing Access To Medical Expertise
. The Clinic Is Two Crews Building One Experience

Mo.
An intelligent, empathetic, multimodal LLM-based conversational AI assistant able to prescribe, triage, and proactively follow up
on care. We kicked off in 2023 and launched Mo to all our French members (1M) in Q1 2026, making it the first safe AI health companion live at scale in Europe.
Clinic Platform.
The medical services behind the conversation: chat with health practitioners, teleconsultation, and care programs
across primary care, mental health, and physiotherapy.

Imagine giving every person in the world instant, 24/7 access to personalised medical expertise
(through chat, voice, or video) with AI agents working in tandem with real doctors and the health system. That's what we are building 🤖🏥.

🚀 What You'll Build And Who You'll Work With

We're building a medical experience that works reliably, safely, and at scale. An AI agent, and the clinic behind it. You'll lead the engineering team and you'll keep building alongside them.

The crews work at the intersection of product engineering, ML engineering, and medical expertise. As their engineering leader, you own:

💬 The team behind the most memorable chatting experience.
Hiring, onboarding, honest feedback, and the mix of skills Mo needs as it grows. Talent density is yours to own.
➕ The architecture for Mo's next chapters.
More context, new skills, new countries. You guide the calls on our architecture and agentic framework, and you stay close enough to the code to make them well.
🏥 The platform that turns conversations into care.
Chat with health practitioners, teleconsultation at national scale, and the tooling doctors and therapists use every day. You drive alignment with the crews and medical teams on the other side, so members get from words to actions.
🛡️ Operational excellence.
Mo and teleconsultation are real-time services that have to be live 24/7. Latency, error rates, incident response, and an on-call rotation that doesn't burn people out.

If you're excited by the idea of building the future of healthcare, this is the team for you. We're at the start of the journey. If you're curious, here is a paper we published recently.

⚡ Why this role is special

Dual impact
: Shape both technical excellence and team growth - your engineers become better while building better products
Leadership growth
: Influence engineering culture, mentor future leaders, and drive technical strategy that shapes the future of healthcare delivery
Startup speed, Alan's platform.
Mo operates with the focus of a startup, on top of Alan's infrastructure, distribution, and health expertise. Small team, huge reach.
Stakes that make the work matter.
In medical AI, reliability and safety are the product. Every call you make on quality, architecture, and evaluation is a call about our members' health.

🔍 What we're looking for

We're looking for an engineering leader who gets excited about building state-of-the-art AI systems and applying them to real-world, high-stakes problems in healthcare.

Leadership experience

3+ years leading engineering teams, with a track record of building high performers.
You partner with other product functions as a true equal: you shape the roadmap, name trade-offs honestly, and help the team commit to what it can actually deliver.

Technical foundations

Experience establishing engineering excellence standards, with the ability to guide architectural decisions.
First-hand experience shipping AI or LLM products to production is a big plus.
You're excited and eager to keep writing code. You still review it, and you still ship some yourself.
Comfortable with modern development practices and AI-assisted development tools.

What we value

Curious, self-starting, humble, collaborative, and eager to grow.
You develop people as much as you develop products.
Ex-founders are typically a great fit in our team.

Mission alignment

Healthcare technology and innovation excite you
You understand that great engineering teams are built on psychological safety and continuous learning

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply!

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you
. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.
We'll be thrilled to receive your application!
